en.name: Eucharistic Fasting of Saint Nicholas of Flüe
en.summary: A Swiss hermit and saint is reported to have lived nearly twenty years without ordinary food.
en.body: Saint Nicholas of Flüe withdrew to a hermitage near Sachseln in 1467 and was reported to have lived without ordinary food for close to two decades, his survival attributed to the strength of the Eucharist alone.
